intl.title: Vanderbilt Admissions - International Costs and Finances

test_policy.notes: SAT or ACT scores are optional for fall 2027 and 2028 entry; required for fall 2029 entry. No test or GPA cutoffs.

requirements.supplemental_essays: Personal essay and short answer through Common App/Coalition. Peabody education applicants answer an extra short question; Blair School of Music applicants submit a music resume, repertoire list and prescreening video.
requirements.notes: Two academic teacher letters (Blair also needs one artistic recommendation) and one counselor letter. No interviews through the admissions office; optional video submissions (Glimpse for US-school students, InitialView for international applicants). QuestBridge applicants get an automatic fee waiver. CSS Profile (or ISFAA) is required for international applicants requesting need-based aid; priority dates are in the deadline list. Vanderbilt does not consider demonstrated interest.

deadlines.notes: Early Decision I. Decision mid-December 2026 (no exact date published).
Early Decision II. Decision mid-February 2027 (no exact date published).
Regular Decision. Decision late March 2027 (no exact date published).

deadlines.label: Merit scholarship application
deadlines.notes: Applies to all three plans. Blair School of Music priority deadline is Nov 1 (ED I) or Dec 1 (ED II and RD).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived if English is the first language or language of instruction, or if ACT English is above 26 or SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing is above 630. Scores must come directly from the testing agency or a school official and are not superscored.

english.notes: Page lists 'TOEFL iBT 5' as a recommended minimum and does not separate old and new scales; 5 can only be on the new 1-6 scale. TOEFL Essentials 10.5 and LanguageCert 75 also listed.
C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency, recommended minimum.

aid.notes: International applicants requesting need-based aid are considered on a need-aware basis (need-blind applies only to US citizens and eligible non-citizens). The page's 100%-of-need pledge is stated for US citizens and eligible non-citizens, not for international students. For fall 2026 Vanderbilt offered aid to 89 international students from 54 countries; awards ranged $16,815-$99,998 per year. International first-years may apply for all merit scholarships (small number of top applicants). Need-based aid requires the CSS Profile or ISFAA.

toefl.note: Page does not list a TOEFL reporting code.

tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (Hoogland business minor only).
tier_notes.nursing: No first-year BSN; Vanderbilt nursing entry is at the master's level.
tier_notes.computer_science: Growing CS department, ranked outside the top 40.
tier_notes.pre_med: Strong pre-med outcomes and research access through Vanderbilt University Medical Center.
tier_notes.arts_design: Blair School of Music is strong.
